positioning: Evidence, assessment and monitoring for environmental and social practitioners.
description: Organize authorized evidence, review requirements and human judgments, track corrective actions and retain portable project records. Software supports the practitioner responsible for the work.
quotePolicy: Offerings are proposed scopes for discussion. No published subscription, usage allowance, service level or delivery date is promised.

offerings.name: Due diligence and monitoring consulting
offerings.outcome: A defined review, cited findings, corrective-action plan and agreed monitoring deliverables
offerings.revenueStructure: Professional fees, fixed deliverable scope or retainer

offerings.name: Reporting and template configuration
offerings.outcome: Reviewed field mappings and repeatable client report outputs from core project facts
inputs: Original template and permission to use it

offerings.name: Managed individual and team workspaces
offerings.outcome: A maintained workspace with agreed storage, recovery, updates and support
offerings.revenueStructure: Proposed subscription with separately scoped expensive processing

offerings.name: Private institutional deployment
offerings.outcome: A customer-controlled or dedicated deployment with documented acceptance evidence
offerings.revenueStructure: Implementation plus support and usage agreement
inputs: Integration, retention and security review scope

offerings.name: Managed AI processing and specialist packages
offerings.audience: Teams with authorized evidence and defined review tasks
offerings.outcome: Bounded draft assistance with exact provenance and human review
offerings.revenueStructure: Proposed included allowance or metered processing after cost review
inputs: Representative evaluation and human review plan

offerings.name: Training and implementation support
offerings.outcome: A repeatable evidence-to-report workflow and operator handover

offerings.name: Portfolio analytics and systems integration
offerings.outcome: Scoped integration that preserves project, evidence and assessment authorities

inquiry.label: Prepare an inquiry brief
inquiry.notice: Prepare a brief to review and share through your chosen contact channel. Contact links open your chosen mail application; this application does not send a message or attach project evidence.
